correctness.rationale: Every semigroup word with t coins is at+2r with 0<=r<=2t; each increment realized because {0,1,2} coin increments fill this range. For residues 2j mod odd a, the minimum is w_j=a ceil(j/2)+2j; increasing r by a can only increase its minimum. For j<=s the left neighbor of any gap is itself missing. For j>s, the two neighbor coordinates are j-s-1 and j-s with u+1 as quotient, giving the precise lower/upper ceiling bounds. Summation of their integer intervals gives floor[s(s+2)/2], and summing Apéry quotients gives genus s(s+2); the largest representative gives Frobenius. Independent dynamic membership enumeration checked every isolated gap, genus, maximum and minimum for all 109 odd a=3..219; no finite enumeration is mistaken for proof for all a.
